info.title: Cost Management Price Estimation
info.description: Estimates prices for proposed configurations using subscription-applicable prices.

get.description: List the operations for the provider

post.description:
Estimates recurring monthly prices and separate upfront charges using prices
applicable to the authorized subscription and its billing currency. Nothing
is deployed or purchased. Upfront amounts are never amortized into monthly
amounts. Commitment periods and payment options are validated against the
selected profile, independently of supplied running hours.

This is a long-running operation. The request is validated synchronously:
invalid input fails the POST itself with HTTP 400 and is never priced. A valid
request returns HTTP 202 with Location and Retry-After headers; polling the
Location returns 202 while pricing runs, then the estimate (HTTP 200) or an
ARM error. Only the caller that started the operation can read its result,
which is retained for 30 minutes.
An accepted request can still fail during pricing if a calculated amount or
aggregate exceeds the supported range. This fails the entire estimate;
polling returns HTTP 400 with error code EstimateAmountOutOfRange, not a
clamped or incomplete success result.

Supported resource types and typed input metadata are discovered separately
through anonymous pricing-metadata GETs outside ARM. Discovery metadata is
subscription-independent and contains no customer prices or entitlements.
It must correspond to this estimation API version. Cached metadata is
guidance, never authorization or a substitute for server validation.
Resource types are matched case-insensitively; resource API versions and
input names must match supported values.

Each entry supplies two named object inputs: resource, an allowlisted subset of
the native ARM resource with exact ARM property names, and usage, consumption
and purchase assumptions such as hours, GB, operations and purchaseOption.
Templates, expressions, references, scripts, customer resource names, deployed
resource IDs, tags, credentials and secrets are prohibited. Omitted inputs with
an applicable advertised default are completed by the server; explicit values,
including zero and false, always win.

Each billable configuration must be represented once. Identical entries are
independently charged, not deduplicated.

Every invalid entry is reported in one error response (MultipleInputErrors
with details when there is more than one). Error targets identify a request
position without echoing its value; an additionalInfo entry of type InputField
names the affected input and, where applicable, its allowed values or a choice
lookup path. Each request is limited to 512 KiB, 100 resource entries, 10000
typed values and eight nested object/array levels.
After defaults and canonicalization, completed inputs are limited to 20000
typed values across all entries, eight object/array levels and 10000 planned
billing charges. Fractional inputs have magnitude at most 1000000000 and at
most six decimal places; integer inputs use the exact safe-integer range.

The final HTTP 200 response body is limited to 4194304 serialized UTF-8 bytes
(4 MiB), 20000 applied typed values, eight object/array levels, 10000
components, 1000 diagnostics and 20000 combined defaulted/assumed field
pointers. Counts include server-added defaults and assumptions and span the
whole estimate. Limits known during preparation fail before acceptance;
limits discovered during pricing or final serialization fail polling with
HTTP 400 EstimateResultTooLarge. No results or pricing issues are truncated.

Component amounts and entry/request totals are each limited to 1000000000
in the billing currency. Checked decimal arithmetic overflow or exceeding
the amount ceiling fails the entire estimate with HTTP 400
EstimateAmountOutOfRange; pricing-time failures are terminal polling errors,
not successful Partial/Unavailable estimates. Monthly and upfront amounts
and known subtotals are checked independently.

A completed estimate can contain incomplete prices when individual components
cannot be priced; every missing or ambiguous price is reported as an issue,
not a zero. Result order matches input order. Each result reports the effective
configuration, the configuration defaults applied and any usage quantities the
server assumed because they were omitted.

Location.description: The Location header contains the URL where the status of the long running operation can be checked.

Retry-After.description: The Retry-After header can indicate how long the client should wait before polling the operation status.

get.description:
Gets the status or result of an estimatePrices operation. This URL is returned
in the Location header of the estimatePrices response. Returns HTTP 202 with
Location and Retry-After headers while pricing runs, then the estimate (HTTP
200) or the operation's ARM error. Unknown or expired operations, and
operations started by another caller or subscription, return HTTP 404
OperationNotFound.

parameters.name: operationId
parameters.description: The operation identifier from the estimatePrices Location header.

202.description: The estimate is still being priced.

Location.description: The Location header contains the URL where the status of the long running operation can be checked.

Retry-After.description: The Retry-After header can indicate how long the client should wait before polling the operation status.

EstimateAppliedValue.description: One input value the server set or changed, in the same typed encoding as request inputs.

field.description: JSON Pointer of the field within the decoded resource and usage inputs, such as /usage/accessTier.

value.description: The value the server priced for this field.

EstimateArrayValue.description: A complete ordered array; individual elements cannot be supplied through separate paths.

items.description: Explicit items, recursively validated. Empty items is distinct from an omitted array.

EstimateBooleanValue.description: A native JSON true or false pricing value.

value.description: Explicit boolean; omission is distinct from false.

EstimateComponentResult.description: A server-defined billable component, such as compute, licensing, disk capacity or bandwidth.

component.description: Stable business component name, unique within the entry.

meterIds.description: Resolved internal pricing meter identifiers, distinct from customer resource IDs. Absent when unresolved or not needed.

upfront.description: Component's upfront charge. A known non-applicable charge is Complete with amount zero.

EstimateContent.description: Resolved pricing configurations and explicitly supplied usage for a normalized month.

resources.description: Charge-once entries. Position correlates results; no customer identifiers are accepted.

EstimateCostStatus.description: Completeness of one charge period. Clients must not treat unknown statuses as Complete.

values.name: Complete
values.description: All applicable charges are known, including explicit free or non-applicable charges.

values.name: Partial
values.description: Some applicable charges are known and others are not.

values.name: Unavailable
values.description: No applicable cost could be determined.

EstimateCostSummary.description:
A summary for exactly one charge period. Complete requires amount and forbids
knownAmount. Partial requires knownAmount and forbids amount. Unavailable omits
both. A known zero is Complete with amount zero; it is never an unknown cost.
Partial knownAmount may be zero only when at least one underlying cost is known.
Amounts are JSON numbers, not strings. Decimal calculations retain intermediate
precision. Component amounts are rounded once to six fractional decimal places,
midpoint away from zero; entry and request summaries sum reported components.
Every component, entry and request amount or known subtotal is limited to
1000000000 in the billing currency. The service uses checked decimal arithmetic
and enforces the ceiling after component rounding and at each aggregation.
Individually valid components or entries can exceed the ceiling when aggregated.
Arithmetic overflow or a ceiling violation fails the entire operation with
HTTP 400 EstimateAmountOutOfRange, including as a terminal polling error when
discovered during pricing. Known costs are never clamped, independently
re-rounded at aggregate levels, or changed to Unavailable to fit the limit.
A rounded-zero amount is not a declaration that the underlying meter is free.

status.description: Independent completeness of this monthly or upfront summary.

knownAmount.description: Sum of known costs only, not a total or an upper bound. Present only for Partial.

EstimateDiagnostic.description: A safe explanation of a pricing gap or an applied assumption.

code.description: Machine-readable code, such as RateUnavailable, AllowanceContextRequired or InputCanonicalized.

message.description: Explanation without input values, customer information or tokens.

target.description: Optional RFC 6901 request location, using entry positions and business field names only.

component.description: Affected business component name when the issue is component-specific.

EstimateEffectiveConfiguration.description: What the server set or changed when completing one entry's configuration, for display and revision.

resourceType.description: The supported resource type, in its canonical spelling.

resourceApiVersion.description: The supported source resource API version.

defaultedFields.description: JSON Pointers of configuration defaults the server applied to omitted inputs.

assumedUsageFields.description: JSON Pointers of usage quantities the caller omitted and the server assumed, such as /usage/storedGB. A non-empty list means the price rests on quantities the caller did not state.

appliedValues.description: Every field the server set or changed: defaulted fields, assumed usage quantities and canonicalized spellings. Every other priced value is exactly what the caller submitted.

EstimateFieldPointer.description: An RFC 6901 field pointer, without submitted values or customer identifiers.

EstimateMeterIdentifier.description: An internal pricing meter identifier, distinct from a customer resource ID.

EstimateNamedValue.description: A case-sensitive allowlisted business name and an explicitly typed value.

name.description: Unique sibling business name, not a customer resource name or a path expression.

value.description: Typed value. Null and coercion from another JSON kind are not accepted.

EstimateNumberValue.description:
A finite JSON number, never string-encoded. Integer-valued inputs are limited
to the exact IEEE 754 safe-integer range. Non-integer inputs have magnitude at
most 1000000000 and at most six fractional decimal places. Supported decimal
values roundtrip through double-based SDK serialization; binary floating-point
arithmetic is not exact decimal arithmetic.

value.description: Parsed using decimal arithmetic. Integer magnitude must not exceed 9007199254740991; non-integer magnitude must not exceed 1000000000. Excess precision and out-of-range values are rejected, not rounded or coerced.

EstimateObjectValue.description: A complete object represented by allowlisted named typed members.

members.description: Unique, case-sensitive member names. Empty members is an explicit empty object, not an omitted input.

EstimateResourceInput.description: One proposed charge entry validated against server-owned metadata.

resourceApiVersion.description: Supported source resource API version; the service never evaluates that resource or deploys it.

inputs.description: Two named object inputs: resource (an allowlisted subset of the native ARM resource) and usage (consumption and purchase assumptions). Omitted values are completed only by applicable advertised defaults.

EstimateResourceResult.description: Cost breakdown and explicit gaps for one input entry.

inputIndex.description: Zero-based input position; not a customer resource identifier.

configuration.description: What the server set or changed in the priced configuration. Absent only when a catalog failure prevented complete validation.

monthly.description: Known and unknown recurring costs for this entry.

upfront.description: Known and unknown upfront charges, never included in monthly.

components.description: Component breakdown, including components whose cost could not be determined.

issues.description: Reasons for incomplete coverage or costs. Nonempty whenever either summary is incomplete.

assumptions.description: Defaults and other assumptions actually applied to this entry.

EstimateResult.description:
Computed costs for submitted pricing inputs, not an ARM resource or invoice.
The serialized UTF-8 HTTP 200 response body must not exceed 4194304 bytes
(4 MiB), including JSON property names, escaping and all server-added values.
Across the response there are at most 20000 applied typed values, eight
object/array levels, 10000 components, 1000 diagnostics, and 20000 combined
defaultedFields and assumedUsageFields pointers. Array bounds below are also
subject to these request-wide totals. All limits apply together: a result
within the count limits can still exceed the byte budget.
The service checks completed configurations before pricing and checks result
counts and bounded UTF-8 serialization before storing success. Exceeding any
result limit fails the whole estimate with HTTP 400 EstimateResultTooLarge,
synchronously when known during preparation or as a terminal polling error
otherwise. Results, defaults, assumptions and pricing issues are never truncated.

currency.description: Subscription billing currency for every amount; never a caller-selected currency or silent fallback.

pricingAsOf.description: UTC instant used to select applicable prices. This is not a future price guarantee.

coverage.description:
Fixed scope marker, not a completeness enum: this operation prices only
submitted inputs, never an entire template or deployment. Completeness is
reported by each charge period's status. Callers separately track template
preparation and coverage gaps.

results.description: Exactly one result per input, in the same order.

assumptions.description: Request-wide assumptions; never raw input values or customer identifiers.

EstimateStringValue.description: A resolved string pricing value; not a template, expression, script or secret.

value.description: Text accepted only when permitted by the selected input definition.

EstimateTotals.description: Separately aggregated monthly and upfront costs across submitted entries.

monthly.description: Recurring monthly aggregate; an upfront payment is never included.

EstimateValue.description:
Base for the five typed variants. The service rejects unknown kinds, unexpected
properties, duplicate JSON members and malformed variants. A missing value is
represented by omission of its named entry, not by null or a sentinel.

kind.description: Exact discriminator selecting a supported typed variant.

EstimateValueKind.description:
Supported decoded kinds. The extensible representation supports client
compatibility with additional kinds in future API versions. Requests must
still use one of the five typed variants supported by this API version;
an unrecognized discriminator is rejected.

values.name: Number
values.description: A finite JSON number, not a numeric string.
